questions.q: If we confess our sins, what is God faithful and righteous to do?
questions.evidence: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness

questions.q: What has the Father's love given us to be called?
questions.evidence: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God

questions.q: "He who doesn't love doesn't know God, for God is" what?
questions.evidence: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love

questions.q: John writes so that believers may know they have what?
questions.evidence: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God
